title: Nav between pages shows blank page until scroll: AnimatePresence mode=wait stalls after exit
close_reason: Root-caused: AnimatePresence mode=wait page transition stalls after exit under App Router children-swap; page stays mounted at opacity 0 until an unrelated re-render (e.g. header scroll handler) flushes the swap. Replaced with enter-only keyed fade in client-shell.tsx; removed manual scrollTo (Next's built-in reset verified). Verified via Playwright matrix: prod build went 4/12 blank -> 0/12; deep-scroll reveals, back button, mobile nav all pass.
